Learn the basics, join the course

1-Day Pool Course @ Denpasar, Bali

A full day in the pool at Cakra Hotel, Denpasar — from basic theory, breath-hold basics, relaxation, your first static and dynamic training, plus a mini equalisation training in their 4 meters deep pool.

Course outline

09:00 – 11:00Theory 1: disciplines and technique, equalisation, relaxation and breathing techniques
11:00 – 12:00Pool 1: static breath-holds (STA), relaxation, body position, recovery breathing, mental strategies
12:00 – 13:00Lunch break
13:00 – 14:00Theory 2: physics and physiological basics of freediving, freediving risks and safety
14:00 – 16:00Pool 2: buoyancy check, finning, dynamic turns, safety and rescue
16:00 – endPool 3: mini equalisation and line training in 4 meters deep
Requirement · able to swim 200m non-stop and non-assisted Certification · Molchanovs Lap 1 or AIDA 2 Pool Format · Classroom + Pool – private or maximum 2 students Location · Cakra Hotel, Denpasar Note · Mask and snorkel available to use, fins can be rented via Trio in Denpasar area

Finished your pool course and would like to continue with the rest of Molchanovs Wave 1 or AIDA 2 course? Still struggling with your frenzel equalisation head down? Perfecting your no-fins technique in the ocean? Come to Amed, Bali and join me in the ocean.

Before you arrive

What to prepare before you start the course or coaching

📍 Freediving Amed · open in Google Maps
  • Make sure you arrive in Amed a day before so you can sleep well and be ready for the session
  • Take care of your health and don't get sick!
  • If you don't have your own fins yet, you can rent it from the school in Amed, or from Trio (a student of mine) if you're in the Denpasar area
WhatsApp to rent fins in Denpasar WhatsApp to rent fins in Amed

Driver recommendation

There's no Gojek or Grab here in Amed — if you need a driver or want to rent a scooter, you can ask Iluh.
